# RIVET EV Charging Site Underwriting Package

Capability ID: rivet-site-underwriting-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/capabilities/rivet-site-underwriting-v1/index.html
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- underwrite an EV charging site
- EV charger investment report
- charging site economics
- evaluate this address for EV charging
- EV charging diligence

## Problem

A charging-site decision needs traffic, competition, demand, utility, incentive, parcel and amenity diligence assembled into one evidence-backed report.

## Inputs

Site/address, intended project context, buyer decision question and authorized site-specific inputs.

## Outputs

Address-specific siting and underwriting package with evidence-state labels, economics, competition, power/incentive context and next diligence.

## Pricing

Current hypothesis $500-$5,000 per site depending on depth; not auto-quotable yet.

## Invocation and authority

Discoverable capability; quote/payment verification required before sale.

Discovery may be automatic. Payment, engineering representations and commitments require explicit confirmation/approval.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
